hook: Your AI gives the same answer to you as it does to your most annoying coworker. That should bother you more than it does.
caption:
Your AI gives the same answer to you as it does to your most annoying coworker. That should bother you more than it does.

Here's what's actually happening when you ask ChatGPT to help you write an email:

It's averaging you.

It pulls from millions of people who've asked similar things and serves you the statistical middle. Which is why the output always feels like it was written by a very confident intern who doesn't know your industry, your tone, or the fact that you hate exclamation points.

The fix isn't a longer prompt. It's not "be more specific." It's that the AI literally does not know how you think.

Do you process information visually or through logic chains? Do you want the answer first and context second, or do you need the reasoning before you'll trust a conclusion? Are you a "give me three options" person or a "just tell me what to do" person?

These aren't personality quirks. They're the difference between an AI response that lands and one you rewrite from scratch.

BootFile maps exactly this — your thinking style, your communication defaults, your decision-making pattern — and turns it into an instruction profile that travels with you into every AI conversation.

Same AI. Completely different experience.

Your coworker can keep getting the averaged version.
